shared_elements: human figure(s) in profile with outstretched arm
raised relief carving of figures and symbols
justification: Both surfaces show relief-carved human figures in profile with extended arms alongside oval cartouche-like signs and disc forms, and A's fragmentary shapes (a disc, an arm reaching toward an oval) plausibly belong to the same sign-and-figure repertoire as B. However, B presents a fully legible composition — a rayed disc above an offering table flanked by adoring figures with dense columns of text — whereas A preserves only isolated, disconnected elements with no discernible scene structure, so relationships and arrangement can barely be matched.
